title: Retractable Hooks And Garment Rod Wall Mount 2-1/2-Inch Solid Brass Carolina | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom storage with a wall mount retractable hook/garment rod that pulls out for 2-1/2 inches of hanging space, then pushes back in when you want a cleaner look.

  • Space-saving retractable design: extends for 2-1/2 inches of hanging room and stows away neatly
  • Solid brass construction: crafted for enduring everyday bathroom use
  • 15 lb capacity: supports coats, robes, towels, and more
  • Coordinated look: part of the Carolina collection for matching versatile bath accessories
  • Wall mount installation: designed for standard interior walls; hardware included

Specs
Material: Brass
Mounting: Wall mount
Hanging space: 2-1/2 in (extends/retracts)
Weight capacity: 15 lb
Dimensions: 3.75 in W x 1.75 in H x 1.75 in L
Projection: 1 in
Product weight: 1 lb
Assembly required: No

Installation
Requires drilling a 3/4-inch diameter hole through drywall and three small holes around. Toggle bolts and mounting hardware are included (6/32 toggles).

Finish options
Offered in multiple designer finish options, including statement colors, to complement transitional bathroom hardware.

_previous.title: Carolina Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
